title: Rename senderTailscaleUserId to senderUserId in Peer/deliver
description:
The I-D uses the transport-agnostic field name senderUserId. The current code uses senderTailscaleUserId, which is Tailscale-specific and breaks wire interop with other implementations.

Files to touch:
- kith-peer/src/lib.rs: DeliverMessageArgs.sender_tailscale_user_id field, serde rename from senderTailscaleUserId to senderUserId
- kith-peer/src/lib.rs: build_peer_deliver_request JSON key
- All test assertions using the old key name
